text_block_list.text:
When I went for a walk in the park with 
Wonder Acute—
Oh, if it isn't Ms. Acute over there!

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
Are you out for a stroll too, Opera 
O-chan? It's such lovely weather, after 
all.

I ran into T.M. Opera O and we were 
exchanging light pleasantries. —It was 
right then.

text_block_list.name: Little Boy
text_block_list.text: Aaaahhh!!

text_block_list.name: Little Boy
text_block_list.text:
I've seen those big sisters before! 
They're, like, always running, right!?

text_block_list.name: Little Girl
text_block_list.text:
"It's already time for the race, isn't 
it?!! Sorry for jumping on you so 
suddenly...!!"

Running up to me were a little boy and a 
girl of about the same height. Their faces 
looked identical, so they seemed to be 
twins, but—

text_block_list.name: Little Girl
text_block_list.text:
"We love watching races so much! We're so 
happy to meet you two!"

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
Oho! It seems the dazzling visage of the 
Overlord is radiant even to our littlest 
spectators!

text_block_list.name: Little Boy
text_block_list.text:
Hey, play with me, big sis! I wanna play 
hide-and-seek tag! I'm not gonna lose when 
it comes to hiding!

text_block_list.name: Little Girl
text_block_list.text:
Huh...! No fair! I want to play in the 
sand! I wanna build a huge sandcastle~!

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
"Oh dear, our opinions seem to be split. 
Whatever shall we do, Trainer?"

Seeing the children's excited faces makes 
it hard to pick just one, but for now, 
let's decide which to do first.

text_block_list.name: Little Boy
text_block_list.text:
Alright! It's a deal! Heh-heh, you'll 
never find me!

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
Well then, I guess I'll be the first "it." 
Everyone, go and hide, okay~?

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
Umm, first of all... Inside the slide 
looks suspicious, I suppose.
(Patter patter――)

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text: Now then, I wonder if anyone's here~?

text_block_list.name: Little Boy
text_block_list.text:
Shoot, I'm gonna get spotted...! But I'm 
not gettin' caught that easily!

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
Oops, I'm gonna get spotted too. Time to 
make my escape!

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
Huh? I just heard a voice... Did they head 
toward the shade of the trees?

text_block_list.name: Little Boy
text_block_list.text:
Ack, you're fast! No way in hell I'm 
letting you catch me...!

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
Ahahaha! Swift as always! Now then, we 
must be moving on!

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
"...Huh? I thought it was this way. Can't 
find it, huh."

text_block_list.name: Little Boy
text_block_list.text:
Hey... Big Sis is super fast, but is she 
bad at finding things?

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
Now then, I wonder. Couldn't it also be 
considered that your own abilities are 
simply outstanding?

text_block_list.name: Little Boy
text_block_list.text:
Ah...!! That's it!! Heheh, I'm definitely 
gonna lead all the way to the finish!!

The boy hidden skillfully, and Wonder 
Acute running swiftly to search for him. 
The game went back and forth for a while, 
but—

text_block_list.name: Little Boy
text_block_list.text: Alllriiiight~!! Time's up!! We winnn~!

text_block_list.name: Little Boy
text_block_list.text: I was pretty good at hiding, wasn't I?!

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
Yes, I heard their voices, but they were 
quite good at hiding, weren't they?

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
Indeed! Boys and girls, that was a valiant 
fight. As your comrade, I couldn't be 
prouder!

text_block_list.name: Little Boy
text_block_list.text:
Heheh, that was a blast! Let's play 
hide-and-seek tag again!

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
Of course~ I'll make sure to get really 
good at finding them before then.

It seemed to have been a great 
inspiration. Wonder Acute was humming 
cheerfully all the way home.

text_block_list.name: Little Girl
text_block_list.text:
Yay! Let's split into teams, then! Whoever 
builds the bigger castle wins!

And so, the girl teamed up with Wonder 
Acute, and the boy teamed up with T.M. 
Opera O.
(Step, step, step, step)

text_block_list.name: Little Boy
text_block_list.text: Hey, hey!! Let's make it way, way higher!!

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
Of course! If it is a castle built by the 
Overlord, it must reach all the way to the 
heavens!
(Crunch crunch, patter patter...)

text_block_list.name: Little Girl
text_block_list.text:
It can't just be big, it has to be a 
pretty castle. That's why we have to build 
it very carefully.

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
Fufufu. Indeed. We have to build a solid 
foundation first, after all.

text_block_list.name: Little Boy
text_block_list.text:
Hell yeah! Look how high this is!! Higher 
and higherâwhoooaah!!
(Rustle rustle rustle rustle...!)

text_block_list.name: Little Boy
text_block_list.text: Aaah--!! M-My castle is...!!

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
Oh dear me... It crumbled down, didn't 
it...? Well then, shall we all work 
together to finish this sandcastle over 
here?

text_block_list.name: Little Girl
text_block_list.text:
...How's this looking, Sis? Is it okay if 
I start building the top now?

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
That's true. Shall we solidify the 
foundation just a teeny bit more?

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
A beautiful roof carries that much more 
weight. You need a solid foundation to 
support it.

text_block_list.name: Little Girl
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, got it! Just a teeny-tiny bit left, 
right!

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
Hmm. Beauty is always backed by strength. 
It seems the same applies to building 
sandcastles.

Following Wonder Acute's instructions, 
everyone worked steadily over time to 
build a single castle.

text_block_list.name: Little Girl
text_block_list.text: All doooone! Castle Wonder is complete♪

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text: "Well now, did you name it after me?"

text_block_list.name: Little Girl
text_block_list.text:
Yeah! If big sis hadn't shown me how, I 
never could've built a sandcastle this 
big!

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
“You're right. It's all thanks to 
Acute-san steadily showing us the way.”

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
Fufufu. I'm so glad you liked it. Next 
time we meet, shall we try making an even 
bigger one~?
